name: Sanctuary
band_note: mean of blouse and sweater entry $89 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Women's pants, jeans, knit tops, sweaters and jackets, pants around $99–$150, sold mostly through department stores and its own site, plus one own store.
origin: Founded in Los Angeles, United States in 1997 by Ken Polanco; Deb Polanco.
